title: Rotate by k with three reversals

steps.caption: Rotate right by 3: the last 3 values must end up in front, in the same order.
reverse all: swap positions 0 and 6, then move both pointers inward.
reverse all: swap positions 1 and 5, then move both pointers inward.
reverse all: swap positions 2 and 4, then move both pointers inward.
The last 3 values are in front now, but backwards. So is the rest.
reverse first k: swap positions 0 and 2, then move both pointers inward.
reverse the rest: swap positions 3 and 6, then move both pointers inward.
reverse the rest: swap positions 4 and 5, then move both pointers inward.
Rotated in place: O(n) time, O(1) extra space. No second array needed.
